newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Delta Bank to issue bonus share.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Delta Bank to issue bonus share.

text.p: The general assembly of Egypt's Delta International Bank agreed to raise paid-up capital by 120 million pounds ($35 million) and approved the issuance of a bonus share for each 20 shares held.
The bank said a published announcement on Tuesday that the general assembly took the decision at its ordinary meeting on Monday.
The capital increase would take the issued and paid-up capital to 300 million pounds ($88 million) from 180 million, coprorate sources told Reuters.

A bank official has told Reuters existing shareholders would be invited to contribute to part of the capital increase and the rest would probably be offered for public subscription. The official could not say how much would be available to the public.
The bank is also proposing to increase its authorised capital to 500.25 million pounds from 200 million.
